REVISION OF SERVICE MINUTE OF SRI LANKA ENGINEERING SERVICE - REVISION No. 03

SECTIONS 6.1, 6.2, 7.3.1.2, 14 and Schedule 01 and Appendix 01 of the Minute of Sri Lanka Engineering Service publishedon the Gazette Extraordinary of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka dated 11.11.2013 No. 1836/6, are revisedas follows :
6.1 Approved Grades, Designations and the number of posts and the tasks assigned to them :
6.2 Combined Number of Officers to be promoted
(Designations belonging to the service are mentioned in Appendix 1)

Note : This cadre may be varied from time to time according to the requirements of public service

7.3.1.2 (v)(a) shall have been promoted to Grade I of Sri Lanka Technological Service with a period of servicenot less than 15 years in the said service as a Technical Officer and have obtained a degree (bachelor of science) from auniversity reconginzed by a University Grants Commission, having followed a 04 year full time engineering course in astream on which recruitements are made and recognized by the University Grants Commission and Sri Lanka Institute ofEngineers.

(b) Shall have obtained a valid certificate by following a course an completing all studies and other requirment ina stream on which recruitements are made and accepted as equivalent to the degree course mentioned in 7.3.1.2(v)(a)above by the University Grants Commission and Sri Lanka Institute of Engineers.

(vi) Shall have been promoted to the Special Grade of Sri Lanka Technological Service serving a period of notless than 21 yeara in the said service as a Technical Officer (including a 05 years’ service in Grade I and have full passedthe National Technological Diploma examination approved by the University Grants Commission.

(vi) “The subject stream of Engineering” shall mean the fields of Engineering such as Civil, Mechanical (orProduction), Electrical, Electronic, Chemical and Geo-resources indicated under special academic streams within thefield of engineering. Provisions shall be made by this minute to include other engineering stream on exigency of service.
